description: For warranty repair, this inspection checklist records reported defect, diagnostic plan, coverage, access, parts, repair method, collateral restoration, and scheduling. Its supporting evidence includes intake photos, installation record, diagnostic readings, removed-part findings, repair photos, and functional test.

subtitle: Warranty Repair Inspection Checklist: trade warranty repair dispatch and verification using original work order, reported defect, and intake photos.
title: Warranty Repair Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during trade warranty repair dispatch and verification when the warranty repair record must identify original work order, installed component, location, completion date, warranty term, customer, and prior callbacks. Complete the applicable handoff for repair verification, customer acceptance, coverage disposition, recurrence action, costs, and warranty-record update.
